summary: Master supplier audits, CAPA, SPC, and scorecards in 5 days. Strengthen supplier quality management and audit reporting. Enquire now.
lede: Supplier quality auditing helps quality, procurement and supply-chain professionals assess supplier controls and manage audit follow-up. The course covers risk-based audit planning, evidence collection, nonconformity classification and corrective-action verification, alongside supplier scorecards and process-control data. Participants practice building audit plans and checklists, reviewing supplier records and tracking corrective actions to support supplier selection, performance monitoring and clear reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already touch supplier quality, quality audits, or corrective action workflows and need more structured methods for evidence, scoring, and follow-up. Supplier Quality Engineers managing supplier corrective actions and audit follow-up. Quality Auditors conducting internal or external supplier audits. Procurement Specialists evaluating supplier performance and approval status. Quality Managers overseeing supplier scorecards and audit programs. Supply Chain Managers balancing continuity risk and supplier conformance. Incoming Inspection Supervisors reviewing nonconforming materials and release decisions. Operations Managers tracking supplier issues that affect production flow. Quality Systems Coordinators maintaining audit records and CAPA logs. Continuous Improvement Specialists analyzing repeat supplier defect trends. Supplier Development Engineers improving process capability at critical suppliers.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, a calculator or spreadsheet tool, and examples of supplier audit findings, CAPA records, scorecards, or incoming inspection reports if your organization permits. Participants benefit from having access to a spreadsheet application and a sample supplier file, while the course exercises can still be completed using the provided templates.
